Container.Name: p5assets
Container.Overview: Monitors your Plex libraries (and optionally Sonarr/Radarr) and the Kometa assets folders for missing posters and season covers (poster, Season00, Season01 …). Multiple worlds (e.g. HD and 4K) with their own assets folders. Upload single images, whole folders or ZIPs via drag & drop – files are automatically named the Kometa way. Includes onboarding, online search (TMDb, TVDB, fanart.tv), a trash with undo, quality checks, notifications via Discord, Telegram or ntfy, and optional login (username/password).
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server and Kometa. Each assets folder must be the same as Kometa's asset_directory and be mounted writable. Only change the host port, not the container port 8080.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port of the web interface (default 8484). The container port stays 8080.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings (Plex token, API keys), preview images (up to 600 MB) and trash (up to 2 GB)

Config.Name: Assets 1 (e.g. HD)
Config.Description: Kometa asset_directory of the first world (e.g. HD). Must be the same folder Kometa uses.

Config.Name: Assets 2 (e.g. 4K, optional)
Config.Description: Optional: asset_directory of a second world (e.g. 4K). Leave empty if you only need one world.

Config.Name: Assets 3 (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: asset_directory of a third world.
